dog.description_text:
Meet Noodle!

There's nothing quite like puppy love, and Noodle has plenty of it to give!

Rescued from Georgia, this adorable little girl is ready to find a family of her very own. Noodle is at that wonderful stage of life where everything is new and exciting, and she's looking forward to learning, exploring, playing, and becoming someone's devoted companion.

Of course, puppyhood comes with plenty of learning and growing, so Noodle will need a family ready to help her become the best dog she can be. With patience, consistency, and lots of love, she's sure to blossom into an amazing lifelong companion.

Now all Noodle needs is someone to say, “You're home.”

Could that someone be you?

Want to learn more? We'd love to tell you! Our bios are just a snapshot, so please reach out to our adoption team with any questions about this dog's personality, medical history, or ideal home. We'd be happy to help you determine if Noodle is the perfect match for your family.

________________________________________________________________________________

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
